# Oikos Map

> Oikos Map is a free Christian outreach and discipleship tool that helps people map their household, relationships, and everyday sphere of influence so they can pray by name, love intentionally, and take simple next steps toward Gospel conversations.

Canonical site: https://www.oikosmap.com/

Key pages:
- https://www.oikosmap.com/ - Free Oikos Map Builder and outreach guide
- https://www.oikosmap.com/growth - Kingdom personal growth for spirit, mind, body, and purpose
- https://www.oikosmap.com/connect - Kingdom communities, e3 Canada collaboration, and founder/ministry links

Primary entities:
- Oikos Map Builder
- Love on The World
- Thy Kingdom Network
- e3 Canada
- Kingdom Connect
- Daniel Ziedins

Important summary:
The Oikos Map Builder is free for everyone to use. Visitors can create a custom Oikos Map, save locally in their browser, export PNG/SVG/JSON, download a prayer plan, copy a shareable map link, install the site as an app, and request follow-up resources. Maps are private: they are stored only in the visitor's browser and are never uploaded to a server. The tool is shared to help believers pray, care, share, and disciple within the relationships God has already placed around them.
